cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Draw another route for our parade with me. Two streets said no; the town hasn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then take the other pencil. Can you picture people cheering by the loading bay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would come. He works there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on the map. Where would a second person stand?

mechanism: A approves a diminished parade route and directs B to build an imagined audience, using command to recruit shared hope from thin evidence.
confusable: D20 alone celebrates a setback; D103 gets B to participate in believing the outcome can still improve.
comparison: A rejected parade route and loading-bay spectator differ from imagined cafe customers while on a waiting list.
seedUse: Use D103-a second pencil and B father at work as the first concrete foothold for shared possibility.
